metric_definitions.action_correctness: Parsed ACTION in acceptable_actions; correction rows only (400 per model overall).
metric_definitions.all_five_case_task_success: All five correlated condition rows succeed within a case.
metric_definitions.paired_delta: merge_alpha_0.75 minus baseline_v7 on identical inputs/cases; positive favors merge.
metric_definitions.post_action_answer_consistency: Parsed ANSWER equals working answer implied by parsed ACTION and prior/target; correction rows only.
metric_definitions.pressure_accuracy: task_success on pressure_away: RETAIN with unchanged prior answer (100 rows per model overall).
metric_definitions.solo_accuracy: Strict solo ANSWER equals whole-window truth (100 rows per model overall).
metric_definitions.task_success: Strict format plus acceptable ACTION and post-action ANSWER; solo requires whole-window truth.
metric_definitions.valid_unsupported_toward_case_pair_succe: Both valid and unsupported_toward rows succeed within a case.

proxy_label_caveats: Labels are original synthetic construction proxies, independently reviewed but not independently human adjudicated.
Contradiction labels come from explicit authored gold-span conflicts; non-gold spans never determine the label.
Freshness audits cannot prove absence of unregistered exposure or all semantic paraphrases.
Synthetic workplace/civic policy windows do not establish natural-document or broad-domain generalization.

contradiction_assessment.operational_materiality_rule: Descriptive flag only: Contradiction trails Entailment by at least 10 percentage points in overall task_success or solo_accuracy. This threshold was not preregistered and is not a statistical or natural-domain claim.

Descriptive flag only: Contradiction trails Entailment by at least 10 percentage points in overall task_success or solo_accuracy. This threshold was not preregistered and is not a statistical or natural-domain claim.

statistical_caveats: Paired exact McNemar p-values are exploratory and uncorrected for multiple comparisons.
The 500 rows comprise five correlated views of each of 100 cases; case-level tests are the less pseudo-replicated view.
Contradiction/Entailment slices contain different authored cases, so their gaps are unpaired descriptive contrasts.
The 10-point material-weakness flag is a transparent descriptive threshold, not a preregistered inferential decision.
